what_i_found: An apocalypse runner where failure never ends the run: every collision permanently reduces the number of people alive, and the story adapts to the survivors. The same desperate mission changes control language from lane-running through an occupied city, to analog free-flight under an AI interceptor, to a physical station cut-off. Optional infrastructure overrides turn side actions into hundreds of millions of lives visibly recovered before the final switch.
